artifact_types: local packaging evidence and push handoff
semver decision with chosen level, alternative level and reason
forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform repository, provider, production, telemetry, incident, local-system, deployment, merge, or rollback mutation outside the exact atomic scope and fresh per-action authorization
invent commands, provider receipts, deployment status, production evidence, incident actions, rollback result, approval, or release evidence
combine readiness with action, observation with rollback, coordination with mitigation execution, or learning with unapproved persistence
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Preflight is read-only: readiness never authorizes packaging, push, pull-request change, merge, deployment, or provider mutation.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
Packaging is local only: it may create approved commits and metadata but cannot push, create or update a PR, merge, tag remotely, deploy, or claim remote delivery.
Readiness cannot mutate remote state and must issue separate merge and deploy verdicts; a passing merge gate neither performs nor authorizes deployment.
inputs: A reviewed change, repository state, delivery policy, and intended publication boundary.
Implemented and reviewed changes with fresh verification evidence.
A pull request, target branch, CI state, version state, and deployment configuration.
outputs: local packaging evidence and push handoff
semver decision with chosen level, alternative level and reason
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 3 related modes: Preflight one verified local change for delivery by checking branch and ref identity, merge base, credentials status, automation stops, evidence, documentation, and remote readiness without mutation.; Package verified local changes into bisectable commits, coherent version and changelog metadata, credential-safe PR material, and a push handoff without remote writes.; Perform a fresh read-only gate over branch, pull request, conflicts, CI, reviews, version drift, deployment preview, rollback, and authorization before merge or deploy.
